class.name: HEGoGeoSelection
class.brief_description: A set of points of a [HEGoGeoOutput].

method.name: size
method.description: How many points this selection holds.

method.name: get_indices
method.description: The point indices, for callers that want to index into [method HEGoGeoOutput.get_attribute] themselves.

method.name: filter_by
method.description:
The subset whose [code]name[/code] attribute equals [code]value[/code].
Returns an empty selection, with a warning, when the attribute is missing or was never loaded.

method.name: split_by
method.description:
This selection grouped by the value of [code]name[/code], as [code]{ value: HEGoGeoSelection }[/code].
Points the attribute is not set on land under a [code]null[/code] key, and an attribute the HDA does not have at all yields a single [code]null[/code] group holding everything, so a handler can fall back to a default name rather than losing the points.

method.name: get_points
method.description:
The named attributes for the points in this selection, as [code]{ name: values }[/code], always including [code]P[/code]. Attributes that were never loaded are left out.
This is the point where data crosses from C++ into GDScript, so ask for what you need rather than everything.
